title: Grateful Dead Live at Star Theatre on 1970-03-08
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a strong early set highlighted by Black Peter and Lovelight, though a surprise guest’s late‑show performance drags the finish down.
ai_review.review: The SBD transfer is clear and well‑balanced, delivering an intimate acoustic vibe that shines on Black Peter and a hot rendition of Lovelight. While most of the show feels "on" and the band sounds tight, the unannounced singer (likely Elvin Bishop) appears for the final songs and many listeners find his contributions jarring, especially on the impromptu blues/​Wake Me Shake Me segment and Katie Mae.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently praised as excellent; show quality is split – early performance strong, but the guest’s late appearance draws significant criticism, leading to a mixed overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑transferred SBD with good balance; reviewers note no major dropouts or muffiness.

poor_songs: Impromptu Blues / Wake Me Shake Me (guest singer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The early and mid‑set flow is tight and intimate, but the surprise guest’s appearance on the final three songs disrupts the momentum and leaves a sour note.
